hits.s: any problems. Drilling of this section was done successfully. Same procedures should be followed on next well. The 22 section was drilled using Bentonite/polymer mud with progressively increasing KCL level to avoid problems with swelling clays in th Hordaland group. Though the clays seemed to be even more reactive than in AS, carbide test performed at the end of the section confirmed that the hole was well in gauge.
